Name: Hearts and Gifts Dialogue Display
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11661]Dialogue Display Framework[/url] to display friendship hearts below the character portrait and weekly gift info (for non-married NPCs) beside the portrait.

You can tweak it by editing the content.json file. If you edit the file while in-game, you can save it and press F5 in-game to reload the file.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11661]Dialogue Display Framework[/url].
